text: Your camera sees everything. It just doesn't know what you care about.
Tell it what to watch for, in plain words. Pulse turns that into one clear question, and keeps checking it.
Every second, a fast model reads the last two seconds of video. Only when something looks likely does a bigger model take a second look.
A sip of water. Someone walking in behind you. Anything you can put into words.
And because it was paying attention, you can just ask.
Every moment becomes a card and a clip, ready to share.
Video stays in memory for three minutes, then it's gone. Only your moments, and a snapshot every thirty seconds, are kept.
Pulse. Tell your camera what matters.
